title: What can a platform-wide AI rollout establish about sales?
abstract: An exposure comparison can show differential growth while leaving the total change in sales unidentified. Under exact relative effects on log(1 + sales) we derive the break-even condition, its sharp support bound and a constructive three-sign example. For a historical-control comparison we derive an exact regression recalibration identity. Applying it to the sales marker in Figure III of NBER w36003 gives a necessary calibration increase of roughly 42% to erase the point estimate under a stated regression-weight condition. Neither calculation estimates the actual platform-wide gain.
